title: Battle order

idle.title: Idle
idle.body: Everyone can enter initiative before the GM starts combat.

active.title: Combat active
active.body: Initiative is locked; turns and rounds continue until pause or stop.

paused.title: Paused
paused.body: Add or remove NPCs without losing the current round.

status.gmIdle: Ready to activate the battle order.
status.gmPaused: Pause active — adjust the battle order and resume when ready.
status.gmActive: Combat in progress — the current turn is highlighted in the list.
status.playerReady: You're ready for the next start.
status.playerPausedGeneric: The GM is adjusting the battle order.
status.playerInitHint: Enter your initiative when the GM starts.
status.playerWaitHint: Wait for the GM's start signal.
status.playerPauseHint: Your turn order is preserved until the GM resumes.

join.description: You're currently outside the initiative list. Submit a request to rejoin.
join.pendingIdle: Request received. You'll be automatically restored to initiative during idle.
join.pendingActive: Request received. You'll be added automatically once combat ends and idle is active.
join.hintIdle: During idle you'll be added automatically after the request.
join.hintActive: During pause or combat your request stays pending until idle.

errors.updateFailed: The battle order could not be updated. Try again.
errors.rollFailed: Not all initiatives could be rolled.
errors.advanceFailed: The next turn could not be started.
errors.joinRequestFailed: Your request could not be sent. Try again.

hidden.title: Hidden from battle order
hidden.pauseHint: Pause or end combat to restore players.

empty.label: Still empty
empty.hint: Add players, NPCs, or handout characters to the list.

resizeAria: Drag to resize battle order width

endConfirm.title: End combat immediately
endConfirm.description: This resets the tracker to idle. Initiative order and active turn are stopped.
endConfirm.body: Use this only when you want to fully abort combat. You can still pause via the main action button.

missingInit.description: Not everyone has an initiative score yet. TomeVault can roll the missing values automatically or you can continue later.

tie.title: Tied initiative
tie.manualDescription: Set the order yourself. Top goes first.
tie.choiceDescription: These participants rolled exactly the same. Let TomeVault draw the order, or set it yourself.

conditions.title: Conditions for {{name}}
conditions.description: Activate or remove status effects on this character.

addNpc.title: NPC
addNpc.name: Name
addNpc.hiddenHint: Hidden NPCs do not appear in the player battle order.

initiativeSwap.title: Initiative Swap
initiativeSwap.subtitle: Swap your initiative score with an ally
initiativeSwap.incapacitated: Alert Feat Swap is not possible if you or your ally have the Incapacitated condition.
initiativeSwap.notInList: You are not in the initiative list.
initiativeSwap.noPartners: No available allies to swap with.

profile.deadHint: Marked as deceased. Shows a skull in the battle order.
profile.zeroHpHint: At 0 HP. Mark as deceased or allow recovery.
profile.alertFeatHint: Can swap initiative at the start of combat.
profile.npcHiddenHint: Hidden NPCs do not appear in the player battle order.
profile.npcVisibleHint: This NPC is visible to players in the battle order.
profile.archiveEmpty: Saved profiles appear here after accepting a role or switching profiles.
profile.removeNpcConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove {{name}} from the battle order?
profile.hidePlayerConfirm: {{name}} will be hidden from the battle order and can rejoin later. Continue?
profile.levelUpChat: {{name}} gained a level and is now level {{level}}! Check your TTRPG rules for what you need to know and/or prepare.
profile.levelDownChat: {{name}} lost a level and is now level {{level}}! Check your TTRPG rules for what you need to know and/or prepare.
